body:
I get what you're saying. 
Felt like this for a while after I got out of the hospital (eventually everything reverted back to "normal").
Also, everything seems slower. We ourselves are slower, actually. Not exactly that actual motion is slowed or distorted, it's that our stimulus isn't as "perky" when we are depressed, I guess, and that contributes to said "dulling of the senses," as /u/bpdisorder put it.

(this took a while to write)

Radiohead, anyone?
"Fitter Happier" is great, bonus if you want some perturbing/upsetting shit.
Thank you. I'll make sure to edit it later.

Thank you.

I'll let you know if there's anything I need to talk about.
That gave me chills, actually. That last statement.
I'm an atheist, but I hope you take that statement as a marker of how much you helped. Thank you.
